name: Bindr: Kink Dating
source:
Bindr is an online dating themed game where you take on the challenge of courting the women you match within the in-game app of the same name. You take on the role of the very author of Bindr, a dating app dedicated to kinky people, to catch a glimpse of how "the other half lives". And by half, I mean the top 1%.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/Bindr/about]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
Bindr是一款在线约会主题游戏，你将接受挑战，在游戏内的同名应用程序中向匹配的女性求爱。你将扮演Bindr（一款专门为变态者打造的约会应用程序）的作者，来一睹“另一半的生活”。我所说的一半是指前1% 的人。

[来自[url=https://www.patreon.com/Bindr/about]Patreon[/url]]
